On the remaining row interval, the explicit moving-sign-zero relation gives dy/dz in (0,1) and strict convexity; weighted AMGM controls the final endpoint for 1/2<=alpha<1. Abel radical and exponential boundary asymptotic follow by exact substitutions and uniform Taylor bounds. The packaged independent numeric quadrature checker passed 125 assertions, but finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.
